review_evidence: books/ihs/* includes logops definitions/lemmas and quotient-remainder/math lemmas; books/unicode/* implements and reasons about UTF-8 encoding/decoding and character predicates.
books/xdoc/* defines the XDOC implementation and tests; even where operational, these files contain named ACL2 functions/macros and concrete formal events rather than declaration-free scaffolding.

Nonempty .sys/*@useless-runes.lsp files are already tagged FD-017 and retained as proof-dependency metadata, while empty generated counterparts are already excluded by FD-001; this review preserves that deliberate distinction.
summary: Reviewed the ACL2 ihs/unicode/xdoc unit. Source books, tests, and nonempty useless-runes metadata remain searchable: the unit mixes substantive integer/logical arithmetic, UTF-8 formalization, and XDOC implementation with proof-dependency evidence, so no further hard exclusion is demonstrably content-lossless.
